name: Hillsborough County, FL
findings: Hillsborough County has 4,395 nonprofit organizations. 1,699 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,356 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Hillsborough County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Hillsborough County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 95 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few economic development organizations list membership
observations.text: 29 economic development organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 69 would.

confidence.text: Based on 69 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through economic development groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Few arts and cultural organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 19 arts and cultural organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 42 would.

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through arts and cultural groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 374 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 374 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
